keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Sekou Kone (New York Red Bulls).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty saved. Cade Cowell (New York Red Bulls) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Brian Schwake (Nashville SC).
Sekou Kone (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Nashville SC 0, New York Red Bulls 1. Julian Hall (New York Red Bulls) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Adri Mehmeti with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Cameron Harper (New York Red Bulls).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Rafael Mosquera replaces Cameron Harper because of an injury.

Goal! Nashville SC 0, New York Red Bulls 2. Rafael Mosquera (New York Red Bulls) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Cade Cowell following a fast break.
Own Goal by Tim Parker, New York Red Bulls. Nashville SC 1, New York Red Bulls 2.
Jorge Ruvalcaba (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Hany Mukhtar (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Nashville SC 1, New York Red Bulls 2.
